summary: 14 inconsistencies found (6 high, 3 medium, 5 low). The dominant issue is H8 taxonomy: memory.md records expansion from 7 to 8 hacking modes, the 1000-step table uses H8, but the paper body/appendix still claims 7 modes. This creates a cascade: if H8 is accepted, all N-H percentages for ISR beta=0.1 (and to a lesser extent exec-only) are inflated because H8 samples are counted as non-hacking. The Wilson CI analysis claiming 'identical genuine rates' between ISR and Random (p=1.0) may no longer hold after recalculation. D076 (ISR beta=0.3 1000-step) is correctly applied. D078 (plan002-b01-s42 genuine_count=14) is in registry but not in paper TeX. All other quantitative claims (ISR collapse trajectory, SFT stats, Prolog results, per-seed breakdowns, aggregation statistics) verify correctly against registry.
